# D’TAILOR (full)

African high fashion house. Founder and creative director: Abdullahi Idowu Olaiya, a Nigerian entrepreneur. Brand based in Accra, Ghana, with an atelier and newly opened storefront on Ecobank Spintex Road. Men’s clothing, women’s clothing, kids and accessories. The store is built for clients who buy remotely as well as those who visit Accra.

Tagline: Designed for your fit and comfort
Statement: Your personality, our craftsmanship. One unique creation.

Site: https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/
Base path: /dtalior/

There is no cart, Stripe, account system, or “add to bag”. Everything on the products and services list is made to order. Ready-to-wear means a look can be requested as seen; the house still makes it. Bespoke and custom is made from the client’s idea and measurements. A customer chooses a making, selects a size (sizes include Made to measure), and messages the house on WhatsApp. Photographed looks are examples. Departments without photographs are still buyable. Making and price are confirmed before work begins. No prices are listed.

## Home (/)

Split hero with the house statement and a kaftan photograph. Short house copy naming Abdullahi Idowu Olaiya. Photographed department doors: Kaftans, Agbadas, Suits, Women’s, Ready to wear. Accra storefront note. Contact: Ecobank Spintex Road, Accra, Ghana; +233 59 566 5083; olaiyaidowu45@gmail.com; Instagram and Facebook.

## Store hub (/shop/)

Grouped: Men’s clothing, Women’s clothing, Kids, Accessories. Every listed making is a buyable option, made to order. Photographed departments use look cards as examples. Other departments still open to a Buy on WhatsApp path.

## Department pages

Filters for colour (13 house swatches), sleeve (short, long), and size (S, M, L, XL, 2X, 3X, 4X, Made to measure) appear on departments that have photographed products. Filters update the grid in place and write a shareable query string. Empty combinations show an empty state.

Every department also has a made-to-order buy panel: size picker, Buy on WhatsApp, and Enquire on WhatsApp.

## Product pages (/shop/<department>/<product>/)

Large photograph, title, short copy, “Made to order” in place of a price, colour / sleeve / size pickers, live summary, WhatsApp buy button (enabled after a size is chosen), and a link to book a fitting. Size options still include Made to measure.

Looks include purple embroidered kaftan, brown pinstripe kaftan, blue patterned kaftan, ivory long kaftan, atelier kaftans, ceremonial agbadas, women’s two-pieces, ready-to-wear sets, a business or formal suit, and a political suit.

## Collection (/collection/)

Lookbook gallery of house photographs. Not the store. Photographed looks can be requested as seen in the store. Made to order.

## About (/about/)

Founder portrait in a purple embroidered kaftan. First-person story from Abdullahi Idowu Olaiya: why he started D’TAILOR, who we are, vision, mission, what the house stands for. Close: D’TAILOR. Crafted for Distinction. Accra, Ghana · Serving clients worldwide · Bespoke · Ready-to-wear · Styling. Site note: every making is made to order, including ready-to-wear requested as seen.

## Book (/book/)

October 2026 Monday-start calendar. Time of day: Morning, Afternoon, Evening. Garment: Kaftan, Agbada, Women’s wear, Ready to wear, Suit, Not sure yet. Every day is requestable. No published opening hours or time slots. WhatsApp receives the day, time of day and garment.
